headline: Bitcoin slipped back below $80,000 as weak big-tech earnings and a hawkish Fed hit risk assets; US growth and inflation data land at 19:30 Bangkok tonight, and Coinbase and Strategy report after the US close.

BTC $79,876 (down 1.12% in 24 hours) and ETH $2,310.70 (down 1.64%) on the price ticker of a Cryptowisser article published Thursday 29 Oct; CoinDesk's same-morning report had BTC near $80,000. stories.title: Bitcoin dips back below $80,000 as big-tech earnings disappoint and the Fed sounds hawkish
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell from above $81,700 to about $79,800 during Thursday's Asian session, undoing a two-day recovery. Disappointing results from Samsung and Alphabet hit tech stocks, and that weakness rippled into crypto, per CoinDesk, a day after the Fed's 'hawkish hold' on interest rates.
points: The Fed held its rate range at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday, a decision CoinDesk described as a 'hawkish hold'.
Alphabet's Q3 operating income was $40.58B against $43.16B expected and its shares were down 10% before the US open; Nasdaq futures were down 1.4%, per CoinDesk.
Samsung's chip profit came in at 106.5 trillion won against 108.5 trillion expected, and its shares fell more than 5%, per CoinDesk.
Forced closures of leveraged crypto bets over 24 hours: $356M per CoinDesk, $369.1M per Cryptowisser citing CoinGlass. Most were bets on rising prices ($205M per CoinDesk, $213M per Cryptowisser).

stories.title: Coinbase and Strategy report tonight; Coinbase adds Ripple's stablecoin and flags a vendor data incident
stories.summary: Coinbase, the US crypto exchange, and Strategy, the company that holds 848,517 bitcoin, both report third-quarter results after the US close on Thursday. The numbers are a read on how much ordinary people are trading and on corporate bitcoin buying. Coinbase also had two pieces of news before the results.
points: Coinbase's live Q&A is at 2:00pm PT (5:00pm ET, 04:00 Friday Bangkok), per Coinbase; Strategy's webinar is at 5:00pm ET, per Strategy.

Strategy holds 848,517 BTC bought for $64.02B, an average of $75,446 each, per Bitcoin Magazine. Its shareholders approved daily dividends on four preferred shares with 99.3% of votes; the first daily STRC payment is targeted for 2 Nov.
Coinbase listed Ripple's RLUSD dollar stablecoin on its app, Exchange and Prime; Moody's rated RLUSD A2, an investment grade, per CryptoSlate.

Coinbase said contact details for a 'small subset' of customers were exposed in a security incident at its analytics vendor Amplitude; it said funds were not affected and gave no count, per CoinMarketCap.

sources.label: CryptoSlate: RLUSD on Coinbase, Moody's rating

stories.title: Bitcoin funds take in money for a third day, ether funds keep losing it, and a big options expiry lands Friday
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in money again on Wednesday, almost all of it into BlackRock's fund, while ether ETFs had a third straight day of withdrawals. About $10.9B of bitcoin options expire on Friday, which can make prices jumpy around it.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $137.33M on Wed 28 Oct, about 22% less than the day before; BlackRock's IBIT took $136.01M and only 2 of 12 funds had inflows, per TokenPost citing SoSoValue.
Spot ether ETFs lost a net $21.41M the same day, their third straight day of outflows; BlackRock's ETHA lost $44.83M, per TokenPost.
About 135,700 BTC of options, roughly $10.9B, expire on Deribit at 08:00 UTC Friday (15:00 Bangkok), with 'max pain' at $78,000, per Tokenist. Max pain is not a price target.
About $780M of ether options expire at the same time, per Tokenist.

briefs.title: Utah files criminal charges against Kalshi
briefs.summary: Utah prosecutors filed 14 criminal counts against prediction market Kalshi and its two founders over alleged illegal gambling promotion; Kalshi called it a 'crazy overreach', per crypto.news.

briefs.title: US sanctions a North Korean IT-worker crypto network
briefs.summary: The Treasury sanctioned 10 people and an entity based in Vladivostok, Russia; two Russian nationals converted more than $5M in crypto for North Korean networks, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Bessent: regulators can fill the gap left by the failed Clarity Act
briefs.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the SEC and CFTC can set crypto rules without Congress after the Clarity Act failed 49-50 in the Senate on 15 Sept, per investingLive.

calendar.event: US Q3 GDP (first estimate), September PCE inflation and jobless claims
calendar.note: GDP expected 3.2% (Reuters poll), prior 2.2%; the Atlanta Fed's GDPNow model had 3.3%. Core PCE inflation expected 3.1% a year, prior 3.0%, per TradingEconomics. Jobless claims expected 199K per TradingEconomics or 196K per CoinDesk, prior 194K.
Deposit rate 2.50%; a hold is expected, per Newsquawk. Press conference 9:45am ET (20:45 Bangkok).
Coinbase Q&A, Strategy webinar and Amazon call all at 5:00pm ET (04:00 Friday Bangkok), per the companies. Token unlocks the same day: FF and CARDS, per the unlock data on this page.
Rate 1.25%; all 16 economists in a CNBC survey expect a hold, per KuCoin. The Bank of Japan has no fixed release time; about 12:00 Tokyo per FinanceCalendar.
At 08:00 UTC. About $10.9B of bitcoin options with 'max pain' at $78,000, and about $780M of ether options, per Tokenist. Max pain is not a price target.
